# Gilbert Blythe & Shirley

- [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) — Rival of — [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) — academic rivals in school · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share a dramatic, tearful farewell near the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble) after Diana's mother forbids them from playing together. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) informs [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) of their permanent separation and decides to return to school, where her classmates welcome her back. Despite the forced estrangement from [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) channels her energy into her studies, engaging in a intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life

A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers she has won the Avery scholarship, while [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) wins the medal, and she attends the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) commencement with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). She returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the summer, reconnecting with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and learning about Gilbert's plans to teach instead of attending college. The next day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) notices Matthew's failing health and Marilla's trouble with her eyes, ending her evening with a quiet walk and affectionate conversation with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream

> Miss Lavendar and [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) are married at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) in a lovely ceremony attended by their friends. After seeing the newlyweds off, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) finish tidying the house, where a brief romantic spark between them hints at the changing chapter of Anne's life.
